title: Healthspan
description: The long-run markers in one place: resting heart rate, HRV, VO2 max, sleep, activity, weight and body fat, medication. Each tile reads one source you pick; the trends draw every source in its own colour.

list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.description: IANA time zone the days and weeks are cut in (TRIBUTARY_TZ).

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.description: The person: the user tag of BodyStats and SleepStats (GarminStats holds one person and has none).

list.name: rated
list.label: Rated scales
list.description: Sources that rate their readings (body_levels): listed first.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "body_levels" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "body_levels" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: scales
list.label: Other scales
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "body_composition" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "body_composition" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: nights
list.label: Night sources
list.description: Every source of nights in SleepStats, for the sleep and heart pickers.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: days
list.label: Daily activity sources
list.description: Every source of daily totals (steps, strain) in BodyStats.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "daily_activity" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "daily_activity" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: workouts
list.label: Workout sources
list.description: The sources of workouts in BodyStats that write no daily total.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "exercise" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "exercise" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: rhr_from
list.label: Resting HR from
list.description: The source of the resting heart rate.

list.name: hrv_from
list.label: HRV from
list.description: The source of the overnight HRV. Devices measure it differently.

list.name: sleep_from
list.label: Sleep from
list.description: The source of the time asleep, the stages and the bedtimes.

list.name: activity_from
list.label: Activity from
list.description: The source of the daily totals (steps).

list.name: workouts_from
list.label: Workouts from
list.description: The source of the workouts. A workout two apps received is in both: pick one.

list.name: weight_from
list.label: Weight from
list.description: The source of the weight and body fat tiles.

panels.title: Resting HR
panels.description: Median of the nights in the range, from the source picked in Resting HR from. Lower is fitter.

targets.query: SELECT median("restingHeartRate") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${rhr_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT median("resting_hr") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${rhr_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: HRV
panels.description: Median overnight HRV (RMSSD) of the nights in the range, from the source picked in HRV from. Devices measure it differently: compare a source with itself.

targets.query: SELECT median("avgOvernightHrv") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${hrv_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT median("hrv_rmssd_ms") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${hrv_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: VO₂ max
panels.description: The watch's latest VO₂ max estimate (ml/kg/min, running), a strong marker of fitness. garmin-grafana is the only writer today.

targets.query: SELECT last("VO2_max_value") FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Sleep / night
panels.description: Median time asleep per night (naps left out), from the source picked in Sleep from.

targets.query: SELECT median("sleepTimeSeconds") / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT median("asleep_s") / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Sleep spread
panels.description: Standard deviation of the time asleep from one night to the next, from the source picked in Sleep from: the lower, the more regular. Bedtimes are on the Sleep dashboard.

targets.query: SELECT stddev("sleepTimeSeconds") / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT stddev("asleep_s") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Intensity / week
panels.description: Moderate minutes plus twice the vigorous ones, per week, averaged over the days the watch recorded. The guideline is 150 or more.

targets.query: SELECT (sum("moderateIntensityMinutes") + 2 * sum("vigorousIntensityMinutes")) * 7 / count("totalSteps") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Steps / day
panels.description: Median steps per day, from the source picked in Activity from (a source of workouts alone has none).

targets.query: SELECT median("totalSteps") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE 'garmin' = '${activity_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT median("steps") FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "source" = '${activity_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Training / week
panels.description: Hours of workouts per week over the range, from the source picked in Workouts from (a workout the watch also sent to a diary is in both: pick one).

targets.query: SELECT sum("elapsedDuration") / 3600 / ((${__to} - ${__from}) / 604800000) FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${workouts_from}' AND $timeFilter

SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 / ((${__to} - ${__from}) / 604800000) FROM "exercise" WHERE "source" = '${workouts_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "category" != 'adjustment' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Weight
panels.description: The latest weigh-in in the range, from the source picked in Weight from.

targets.query: SELECT last("weight") / 1000 FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' = '${weight_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("weight_kg") FROM "body_composition" WHERE "source" = '${weight_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Weight change
panels.description: The last weigh-in of the range minus the first, from the source picked in Weight from.

targets.query: SELECT (last("weight") - first("weight")) / 1000 FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' = '${weight_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("weight_kg") - first("weight_kg") FROM "body_composition" WHERE "source" = '${weight_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Body fat
panels.description: The latest body fat reading in the range, from the source picked in Weight from (a source that records weight alone has none).

targets.query: SELECT last("bodyFat") FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' = '${weight_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("body_fat_pct") FROM "body_composition" WHERE "source" = '${weight_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Doses taken
panels.description: Share of the scheduled doses logged as taken, every medication app together (a dose has one).

targets.query: SELECT mean("taken") FROM "medication" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Resting heart rate
panels.description: Each night's resting heart rate (points) and its 7-night average (line), one colour per source.

targets.query: SELECT mean("restingHeartRate") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("restingHeartRate"), 7) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("resting_hr") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("resting_hr"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Heart rate variability
panels.description: Each night's HRV (points) and its 7-night average (line), one colour per source. Devices measure it differently: read each line against itself.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avgOvernightHrv") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("avgOvernightHrv"), 7) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("hrv_rmssd_ms") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("hrv_rmssd_ms"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Time asleep per night
panels.description: Time asleep each night (points) and its 7-night average (line), naps left out; the dashed line is 7 hours.

targets.query: SELECT sum("sleepTimeSeconds") / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(sum("sleepTimeSeconds"), 7) / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("asleep_s") / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("asleep_s"), 7) / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: VO₂ max
panels.description: The watch's VO₂ max estimates (ml/kg/min), running and cycling (dashed).

targets.query: SELECT last("VO2_max_value") FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none)
SELECT last("VO2_max_value_cycling") FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none)

panels.title: Intensity minutes per week
panels.description: Moderate minutes plus twice the vigorous ones, per week (Monday to Sunday); the dashed line is the 150-minute guideline.

targets.query: SELECT sum("moderateIntensityMinutes") + 2 * sum("vigorousIntensityMinutes") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Workout time per week
panels.description: Hours of workouts per week, one line per source: a workout the watch also sent to the food diary is in both lines.

targets.query: SELECT sum("elapsedDuration") / 3600 FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" != 'adjustment' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d), "source" fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Weight
panels.description: Every weigh-in, one colour per scale or app.

targets.query: SELECT "weight" / 1000 FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT "weight_kg" FROM "body_composition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Body fat
panels.description: Every body fat reading, one colour per scale. Scales estimate it differently: compare a scale with itself.

targets.query: SELECT "bodyFat" FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT "body_fat_pct" FROM "body_composition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Steps per day
panels.description: Steps each day (points) and their 7-day average (line), one colour per source.

targets.query: SELECT sum("totalSteps") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(sum("totalSteps"), 7) FROM "DailyStats" WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT "steps" FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT moving_average("steps", 7) FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Doses taken per week
panels.description: Share of the week's scheduled doses logged as taken, every medication app together.

targets.query: SELECT mean("taken") FROM "medication" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
